scope.method: Static lexical scan of src/**/*.asm and src/**/*.c. Direct INT/port/interrupt instructions and selected absolute BIOS/ROM/segment-pointer expressions are inventoried. This is not a callgraph, execution proof, or exhaustive recognition of indirect device access.

classification_notes: Assembly procedure classes are lexical and local. BIOS/DOS interrupt, port I/O, CLI/STI, or IRET marks a hardware/interrupt/service boundary. LES/LDS, segment overrides, or loading DS/ES/SS without such a boundary is a separate DOS segmented-memory ABI class; it is not called hardware. A procedure in a hardware-oriented module may still be ordinary code.

The C function association is a brace-aware lexical approximation. Function-like macro bodies and file-scope segment declarations may have function=null. Do not treat this field as a compiler-derived callgraph.
Only selected absolute BIOS/ROM addresses are recognized; the source audit does not claim that every numeric pointer or indirect far access is classified.

assembly_registry_reconciliation.difference_explanation: Manifest has 367 ASM claims and source has 350 PROC bodies (+17 net). Seven manifest ASM claims are in-procedure labels aliasing named S21 PROC bodies. Of the 24 claims without PROC spelling, those seven alias actual procedures; the remaining 17 unaliased claims comprise five interrupt-handler code-entry labels, ten far-jump thunk entries, one interrupt saved-state data extent, and one cursor callback/alignment address alias. The exact rows retain source line/address evidence; this is count reconciliation, not behavioral admission.

native_window_record_adapter.model: single borrowed mutable fixed-width source window buffer owned by the source Handle cell; host-width object pointer and typed Handle-slot lvalues live in registry sidecars

source_conversion_map.operation: the original function walks count@+0c, table bytes@+2c, objects starting +2c+count*4, advancing by signed size word@object+22; pointer table entries are runtime four-byte DOS slots

validity_limits: Draft conversion has strict source-shape checks for the six listed files; it is not a whole-program compile/admission or runtime-equivalence claim.
Type 4 and type 16..18 serialized runtime fields may be nonzero during initial bind because source clears them only after RepointObjects; slot access is withheld until those exact fields are zeroed.
Type 10 +34 is not cleared by LoadWindow; a nonzero serialized DOS Handle stays unchanged and returns an explicit unresolved-handle failure.
Allocator Handle-cell identity must remain stable across relocation; an owner-cell replacement is rejected. Registry detach is mapped only on the observed source discard path.
No actual database-resource integration or original DOS differential is claimed; arbitrary saved Handles, unknown slot/type pairs and unconverted source sites remain explicit debt.
